final:
Updated the Core, JSON, and YAML 1.1 integer tags to expand exponent-form integer representations into plain decimal digits. Integer parsing rules remain unchanged, so exponent notation is still rejected for explicit `!!int` tags; the existing handling of fractions and negative zero is preserved.

**Verification:** `SUFFICE_WORKSPACE="$PWD" node --test tests/visible.test.mjs` passed all 7 tests. An additional check passed for large positive and negative integers, including `Number.MAX_VALUE`, across the default, Core, JSON, and YAML 1.1 schemas, in scalars and collections, and confirmed explicit `!!int` exponent notation is rejected.

The bare test command initially failed because `SUFFICE_WORKSPACE` was unset; setting it to the workspace path allowed the tests to run.
